messages:
Hana Lee: Hi all  I accepted the orientation invite but the event shows 07:00 on my calendar (I'm GMT+2) and the Zoom link is missing. Also the invite says Fri but my calendar shows Thu? Did anyone else see weird DST shifts? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hello Hana! We run separate cohorts. If your event day/time looks off it could be a DST / timezone-mapping issue. Recording will be posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings. Organizer: Omar Haddad.
Omar Haddad: Thanks for the ping @Hana  we've had a few daylight savings edge cases this month. The APAC/EU cohort is actually Friday 09:30 CET (so 09:30 GMT+2 right now). Some calendar clients render recurring events using the original timezone which can flip the displayed day when local DST rules differ.
Omar Haddad: Quick fixes: 1) Open the single occurrence -> More actions -> Export .ics and import it into your calendar; 2) If you use Outlook, set the event timezone explicitly (Edit event -> Time zones) instead of floating; 3) If mobile shows wrong day, remove the subscribed calendar and import the single .ics.
Hana Lee: Thanks  I tried importing the .ics but the file I got had DTSTART with a TZID that my client didn't like. Any way to get a raw join link?
Omar Haddad: Sure: https://zoom.us/j/4445556666
Omar Haddad: Passcode: onboard-2026 (case sensitive). We'll also pin the join URL in the #new-hires channel and add it to the Welcome email thread.
Riley Gomez: FYI I ran into the same thing last month when clocks changed in Europe. The recurring series was created in PST so Outlook showed the wrong date locally. Importing the one-off .ics fixed it for me.
Hana Lee: If I end up missing the live session because of the mixup, where do I find the recording and how long is it kept?
People Ops (Jules): Recordings + transcripts are uploaded to Confluence at /onboarding/recordings within 24 hours. Default retention is 90 days; if you need longer-term access request archival by emailing people-ops@redwood.com. If you need the recording sooner DM me and we'll share a direct Google Drive link.
Hana Lee: Is the recording going to include the slides and the Q&A chat?
People Ops (Jules): Yes  recording + transcript + slides and the public Q&A thread will be bundled. Private account details discussed during live setup are not included.
Riley Gomez: Accessibility note: we can enable live captions or request a signer if needed. Reach out to people-ops 48+ hours in advance.
Omar Haddad: Also note: if your calendar shows two orientation entries (one weekly series and one single event), it's usually because you subscribed to the global series and were also invited individually. Remove the subscription or accept only the single event to avoid duplicates.
Hana Lee: I accepted the one-off after importing the .ics and it looks correct now  thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Onboarding Bot: Organizer updated event metadata: timezone=CET, region=APAC/EU, added Zoom link to description, pinned join link in #new-hires, attendees re-notified. :white_check_mark:
Omar Haddad: Welcome aboard @Hana  if anyone else has calendar oddities DM me and I can send a corrected .ics or add you to the right recurrence. We'll drop the recording link in this thread after the session.
